# Private maximal footprints: persistent protection for the first reserve

2026-10-10 UTC. Prospective analytical and verification contract. OPEN pending verification and reviews. Parent bdcd6fd4200e955e71a5cab72710600609d322fe.

## Setting
Inherit the original finite core, active palette P of N actual identities, positive original floors F, original core hitting number in {3,4}, and fixed original protected hidden completions. Safety means original floors, core hitting number at most four, and every current footprint contained in an ORIGINAL footprint. Only one-incidence toggles are native edits. Original observation/access/source/outcome and committed progress are supplied assumptions.

Let M_1,...,M_k be ALL distinct inclusion-maximal original footprints. Hypothesis PRIVATE: for each i there is a root p_i in M_i and in no other M_j. No disjointness of the maxima is required. Equivalently, the family of all maxima is an irredundant cover of the roots. In this setting PRIVATE implies source hitting number k, hence k is 3 or 4. Conversely k equal to the source hitting number implies PRIVATE. Choose ANY actual original label a_i whose footprint equals M_i, and put A={a_1,...,a_k}. Such labels exist by definition, and are distinct. A is an actual source cover; its incidences will remain unchanged.

## Theorem: anchor subtraction is an exact count-graph isomorphism
Use M_0=empty. The inherited unrestricted maximal-type count graph has counts n_0,...,n_k summing N; vertices meet F and the upper-four cover gate. Exact-meet edges transfer one donor from type i to j and require the resulting intersection core to be safe.

Every feasible vertex has n_i>=1 for every i>0: the positive floor at private p_i can only be met by labels assigned M_i. Every vertex therefore has core hitting number exactly k and its upper-cover gate is automatic. In a safe edge leaving i>0 for j!=i, the donor loses p_i at the meet. Consequently n_i>=2 (indeed n_i>=F(p_i)+1). An edge can never need the last occupant of a nonempty type.

Let b(x)=number of maxima containing root x and G(x)=max(0,F(x)-b(x)). Define m_0=n_0 and m_i=n_i-1 for i>0. This is a bijection between unrestricted feasible vertices and nonnegative residual counts of total N-k satisfying G. For residual vertices use the same original maximum types and empty type, with no additional cover constraint. Subtracting the unchanged A contribution b proves floor equivalence at vertices AND exact meets. Every unrestricted edge has an available non-anchor donor by the preceding private-root argument, and corresponds to one residual edge. Conversely every residual edge lifts after adding one fixed anchor per type. Thus the whole graphs, not only their source components, are isomorphic under this shift. Residual floors may be zero; ORIGINAL floors remain positive and unchanged.

More strongly, every residual edge lifts from EVERY actual assignment of the non-anchor labels with those residual counts. Select any donor of the specified type, delete its incidences to the exact intersection, then add incidences within the destination maximum. Every intermediate slice contains the safe meet plus unchanged anchors, preserves original floors/domination and has actual cover A. Anchors are never edited. The arbitrary-parameter and arbitrary-hidden-completion assertions follow from this proof and the inherited universal safety criterion, not from finite masks.

## Reachability consequences and limits
Expand each original non-anchor footprint into any containing original maximum. Anchors are already maximal and remain fixed. Expansion is safe with A, and different expansion choices connect through their common original core. Inherited native-path compression gives unrestricted reserve accessibility from any source expansion; the isomorphism lifts its count walk from the ACTUAL expanded source while leaving A fixed. Counts do not identify a prescribed labelled endpoint.

Therefore ANY first reserve is safely reachable iff it is reachable without ever editing A. This holds for EVERY allowed original anchor choice A, not merely for one favorable choice. Truncate at the first vacancy when necessary. No assertion that a vacancy exists follows: source-component membership is still required. The source-component minimum active count equals k plus the residual source-component minimum nonempty count; global static minima obey the analogous formula, but need not equal accessible minima.

For any prescribed label r outside A, ANY reserve reachability is equivalent to r-absence reachability with the SAME fixed A. If the obtained vacant label is not r, copy r's current footprint into that vacant label, then delete r's footprint, preserving A, floors and original domination. This may occur after an earlier vacancy and is not an exact labelled-target theorem. No such statement is made for r in A.

Contrapositive: if an instance in the inherited setting forces protection to move before ANY first reserve, its maximal footprint family has a redundant member (k>source hitting number). This necessary condition is NOT sufficient. Overlap alone is not the obstruction, and sources with PRIVATE may still have no reachable reserve. Broad C3/general C4 remain OPEN.

## Prospective finite contract (before execution)
For k=3 use four roots: three private roots indexed0,1,2 and shared root3. For EVERY nonempty subset S of {0,1,2}, take maxima M_i={i} union {3 if i in S}. For k=4 append fifth root4 and maximum {4}. For EACH such maximum family choose EVERY nondecreasing pair of nonempty footprints contained in at least one maximum; the source consists of the k maximum labels followed by these two extra labels, so N=k+2. Preserve all source identities even when symmetries occur. Use saturated floors and componentwise max(1,source-size-1), retaining both mode identities. No source selection by outcomes.

For EVERY case: independently enumerate the entire unrestricted count graph (including empty type), entire residual count graph, complete edges and components, and compare the exact shift at vertices, edges and source components. Enumerate EVERY choice of actual original maximal anchors and EVERY expansion of all other source labels. Check all choices belong to the correct common source component. Enumerate ALL labelled residual assignments, all exact-meet edges and canonical native lifts. Check every residual edge from EVERY representative, all original floors/domination, fixed actual anchors, and all ORIGINAL protected one-hidden masks for every distinct lifted native core (count occurrences separately). For each anchor choice and each source expansion compare ANY vacancy and EACH non-anchor prescribed vacancy accessibility in the full labelled residual graph, including canonical copy-then-delete rename witnesses. Record complete canonical identities before hashing; checker reconstructs the full declared universe without trusting supplied case lists or counts. No raw full-incidence-cube enumeration is claimed.

Include explicit saturated overlapping positive source maxima {0,3},{1,3},{2} with extras {0},{3}: expand extra{0} at3 then delete extra{3}, leaving all anchors fixed. Its k4 singleton suspension is also checked. Include saturated all-maximal-only negative controls for every maximum family (N=k), and private-root-loss meet rejection with positive floors; reject a no-PRIVATE triangle family as outside theorem scope. Verify PRIVATE iff k equals source hitting number over all declared sources and that no safe edge takes the last nonempty type occupant.

Genuine RED contracts precede implementation. Test omissions/corruption of source/mode/anchor/expansion/vertex/edge/component/lift/vacancy/rename identities and loss of positive original floors. All253 inherited contracts must pass. Complete independent implementations, internal mathematical/code review, fresh byte-equal CI reproduction, exact-event Gemini mathematical and separate publication reviews, original ZIPs/full logs/raw responses/hash manifests/retry history, author reconciliation and separate publication audit, immutable readback before CLOSED.

This is a structural no-movement theorem for first reserves, not a general availability theorem, physical derivation, native access mechanism, new primitive, optimal-cost claim or full-stack certification. Path A active; Path B closed. No fundamental-time/dark-matter variable or inserted geometry.

# Universal core-region criterion and reserved-label bypass — closeout

Status: scoped theorem CLOSED. Exact repair on the saturated disjoint-role template is OBSTRUCTED with only active labels and CONSTRUCTIVE with one reserved unused core label. Broad C3/general C4 remain OPEN. No numbered v16 or full-stack/post-merge certification is claimed.

## Scientific discovery

For an original finite nonempty core C with hitting number 3 or 4, positive original floors at most core sizes, and ALL protected completions by a disjoint nonempty hidden palette, a candidate core D is universally admissible exactly when:

1. Its core supports satisfy the original floors.
2. Its core hitting number is at most 4.
3. Every current core-label footprint is contained in some original core-label footprint (empty footprints allowed).

This removes the hidden-completion quantifier from this safety decision. Necessity uses a single hidden label on the complement of a violating footprint; sufficiency replaces current core hits by original core hits and leaves hidden hits unchanged. The original C remains the reference throughout a path. Arbitrarily many hidden labels are covered by the proof, not by extrapolation from the finite census. The criterion decides admissibility, not general connectivity or native observer origin.

The saturated template has m roots with {A}, two singleton roles {B}, {C}, and host {D,E}. With only these five active labels it has NO uniformly safe first edit across its full source fiber: deletion violates a floor in the empty-hidden world; every valid addition mixes disjoint original footprints. With one reserved globally absent core label w, use +w at host, remove D there, add D at ALL m A-roots, remove A at ALL those roots, add A at host, and remove w. Every slice is universally safe and the endpoint exactly exchanges A,D while preserving hidden incidences.

The route uses 2m+4 committed toggles, the sharp uniform minimum: 2m+2 endpoint differences plus at least two off-endpoint toggles. Peak excess is max(1,m), not a single-excess claim. Current core and the supplied ordered template identify the next request and exact endpoint. Optional NOOPs can stall forever; no physical progress law is derived.

This does not make the previous fixed-family admission predicate true. The hidden common label can persist while the SAME intended exact repair destination is reached by another route. Buffer choreography was already known; the new result is the exact universal criterion and its full-completion operational application, including resource necessity and uniform optimality. Core access, static addresses, original protected-band knowledge and reserved-label availability remain explicit premises.

## Reproducible evidence

- [Prospective scope/proof freeze](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/commit/49227fd7c18fe4ec358817102e1e31ff43d8c965).

Proof and scientific code are unchanged between runs; review evidence/instructions were corrected.

The bounded census reconstructs 12,913 candidates: 4,096 each on three complete declared core domains and 625 empty/singleton candidates on a four-root tau4 source. Universally safe counts are 60, 6, 6, 24 respectively. The m=3 repair is checked on all 53 protected one-hidden-label completions, through all 11 slices (ten edits). These are executed counts, not prospective analytical predictions.

All 50 tests pass: four positive contracts, two explicit native rejecting controls, 16 corrupted-certificate controls, and 28 inherited fixed-family tests. Cross-role addition has a native tau 3-to-2 witness; premature deletion raises empty-world tau to 5; a separate five-root candidate rejects an omitted upper-bound condition. Complete independent reconstruction uses sets and minimum representative unions, while production uses bits and subset hitting enumeration. All canonical row values, memberships and types must match. Fresh mathematical and separate publication reviews both returned ACCEPTED, with zero listed missing assumptions/counterexamples. Model: gemini-3.1-pro-preview. Reviewed hashed inputs: 21 mathematical and 24 publication. These are adversarial AI assessments, not proof-assistant certification.

# Anchored donor release and exact-permutation restoration — scoped closeout

Status: **CLOSED for the declared two-stage monotone-release theorem and its exact verification contract.** Broad C3/general C4, native observer/core access, source admission, outcome selection, and guaranteed progress remain OPEN. This is not numbered-v16 or full-stack certification.

## Mathematical result

For a finite original core `C`, active palette `P`, fixed positive original floors, and `3 <= tau(C) <= 4`, fix an occupied reserve label `r`. A two-stage path that first adds only non-`r` donor incidences and then deletes every original `r` incidence exists uniformly over every original protected hidden completion exactly when each donor `d != r` can be assigned to an inclusion-maximal original footprint `phi(d)` such that:

1. its original footprint is contained in `phi(d)`;
2. the assigned donor incidences satisfy every original floor; and
3. at most four assigned donor footprints cover all roots.

The construction is explicit. Add donor incidences within their assigned original footprints, then delete `r`. Original floors, original-footprint domination, and an actual upper-four cover hold at every slice. This criterion is exact only for the declared monotone class; its failure is not a general connectivity obstruction.

Once `r` is absent, whole-footprint renames implement any exact palette permutation, including one moving `r`. Concatenating the release path, the rename path, and the reverse of the permuted release path reaches exactly the labelled endpoint `pi(C)`, fixes every hidden incidence, and removes all preparatory donor incidences in their prescribed images. Relabelling the same certificate renews the interface for any finite prescribed permutation sequence.

The saturated multi-donor example `({r,a},{r,b},{a,c},{b,d},{e})` shows the new mechanism: two donors protect distinct maximal regions, so a common donor backbone is unnecessary.

Build vertices by assigning each existing label a member of M or the empty footprint, subject to original floors and an actual at-most-four-label cover. # Fully saturated first-reserve handover — scientific closeout

## Proven result and boundary
In the declared crossed-block family, every original floor is saturated and every anchored monotone-release certificate fails. For r>=3, an existing nonmaximal donor creates slack, three existing donors change their maximal-container roles, and the old backbone becomes the FIRST absent label. The achieved route uses 4r+6 single-incidence edits. All floors remain intact; every original root cardinality is restored exactly. Static minimum is r+4=N-1 and is reached. For r=2, safe additions exist but the private-incidence count obstructs any static vacancy: kappa=N=7.

The inherited absent-label interface then gives exact full-palette exchange/permutation, restoration and renewable finite sequences, including moving the reserve. Original u,v,e remain an actual three-label cover; all ORIGINAL hidden completions stay protected, with full tau exactly3 along the scripted construction. This is a fully saturated positive family, not a general saturated availability theorem and not an optimal raw-edit route claim.

Separately, the maximal-footprint count graph is an exact orbit quotient for FIRST-reserve reachability. One-label type moves use a safe intersection meet gate; every count edge lifts from every assignment with its source counts. A first vacancy exists on a safe reachable path exactly when the source component contains n0>0. Prescribed absence follows by safe renaming into that vacancy. The source-component minimum active count distinguishes accessible reserve capacity from the global static minimum. The binomial(N+k,k) vertex bound is polynomial only at fixed k. Counts do not decide exact labelled-target connectivity: the saturated singleton permutation has equal counts and no safe first toggle. No native optimal-cost or general polynomial-time claim.

Run [38079576180](https://github.com/proteinfoldingengine/WetLabEngine/actions/runs/38079576180), at the exact scientific SHA above, completed all four jobs successfully: verification, fresh reproduction, mathematical review and publication audit.
